title: Broken health-transition guard in Risk.checkValidTransition (F-1 Critical collateral-withdraw bypass + M-1 Medium de-risk DoS — one inverted comparison, two symptoms)
root_cause: Single defect in Risk.checkValidTransition: the value/risk ratio guard at Risk.sol:133 is inverted (it reverts when health IMPROVES and passes when health WORSENS) and its value-decrease backstop is gated on initTotalRisk==0 (dead whenever a position exists). Manifestation A (F-1, Critical): a risk-constant collateral withdrawal reduces the guard to initValue<updatedValue, so any account holding a position can remove all collateral without the margin check reverting => bad debt. Manifestation B (M-1, Medium): an under-margin account that partially de-risks (health improves) is reverted by the same inverted guard => cannot recover incrementally. One fix resolves both.
attacker_capabilities: sign a withdrawal of own full collateral (ALLOW_WITHDRAW on own account)

severity_justification.worst_case: Attacker extracts full margin and walks from a losing position => unrecoverable protocol bad debt.
severity_justification.realistic_case: Any leveraged user can under-collateralize at will; systemic insolvency / other users cannot withdraw.
severity_justification.program_table_mapping: see official program impact table (not bundled)

bounty_program_mapping.scope_reference: TipRun contest (tiprun-contracts-main @ d5d4d2a); official scope list not bundled with PoC package.

call_trace: submit signed Withdrawal for full 10000 via MultiTransactionProcessor
withdrawal succeeds; collateral 0, position still long 5000, risk > value*FXP (under margin)

state_transition.after: collateral=0, long synthetic=5000, risk>value*FXP (liquidatable), 10000 tokens extracted

asset_delta: 10,000 collateral tokens leave LoadingZone; position of 5,000 left unbacked => protocol bad debt on adverse move.
reproduction_steps: forge test --match-contract PoC_MarginBypassWithdraw -vv   # Manifestation A (F-1, Critical)
forge test --match-contract PoC_DeriskDoS -vv              # Manifestation B (M-1, Medium)

defense_analysis.why_it_fails: only requires bucket-0 collateral >= amount; ignores open-position margin
value-decrease guard skipped when initRisk>0; ratio guard does not fire for risk-constant withdrawal

evidence_links: src/core/risk/Risk.sol:checkValidTransition (inverted ratio guard line 133 + dead initRisk==0 backstop line 136-140)
corroborating B: test/PositionManager.Risk.t.sol::test_RiskRatioComparisonLogic (ratioImproved == the contract's revert condition)
triager_summary: Broken health-transition guard in Risk.checkValidTransition (one inverted comparison, two symptoms). A (Critical): withdraw 100% collateral while holding a position => 10000 tokens extracted, account left under maintenance margin (PoC_MarginBypassWithdraw passing). B (Medium): an under-margin account's fair partial de-risk reverts 'PM: val/risk dec' (PoC_DeriskDoS passing). One fix resolves both.
vrt_category: Business Logic Errors (broken maintenance-margin validation in `Risk.checkValidTransition` → protocol insolvency / fund loss)  ·  Blockchain → DoS with (Unexpected) revert (Manifestation B / M-1: inverted ratio guard reverts legitimate de-risking)

cvss.aspect: Manifestation B (M-1, de-risk DoS / unexpected revert)
